captions.detailed: A quick-release bench vise featuring a dark blue body, flat jaw plates, and twin silver guide bars. A red side-mounted release lever is attached to the side, and a silver lead-screw handle is positioned at the front. The moving jaw slides prismatically along the guide bars, while the side lever rotates to disengage the internal half-nut.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a quick-release bench vise with a dark blue base body, twin silver guide bars, a sliding jaw, a front screw handle, and a red side-mounted release lever.
captions.factory: Construct the main base body using combined box primitives. Model the guide bars as cylinders and the jaw plates as thin boxes. Create the release lever assembly using a cylinder for the pivot, a box for the arm, and a sphere for the handle knob. Define a prismatic joint for the sliding jaw and a revolute joint for the side lever.
